title: Nine Issuers Block Their Shares from Trading on OKXICE's Tokenized Venue
why_it_matters: The objections show that issuer consent safeguards can materially narrow third-party tokenized-stock listings even after a venue qualifies for the SEC's temporary exemption.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

Nine Issuers Block Their Shares from Trading on OKXICE's Tokenized Venue

OKXICE disclosed timely objections from nine U.S.-listed issuers, preventing their tokenized shares from trading on its proposed venue under the SEC's temporary framework.
